2610.05378.title: Distributed Subliminal Learning: Replacing Model Updates with Random-Carrier Outputs
2610.05378.paper_summary: Collaborative learning typically exchanges model parameters: federated clients communicate updates, while independently adapted foundation models are combined by exchanging adapters or checkpoints. This makes communication scale with model size and requires local specializations to be reconciled in weight space, where interference is common. We ask whether knowledge can instead be shared through model behavior on task-unrelated inputs. We introduce Distributed Subliminal Learning (DSL), a collaborative learning primitive in which participants adapt a common model locally, probe it with task-unrelated inputs, and transmit only the resulting carrier outputs. A coordinator pools these outputs and distills them into a shared model. The primitive supports one-shot foundation-model composition through carrier completions and iterative federated learning through carrier logits, without transmitting model updates or requiring task-related proxy data. In LLM composition, compared with LoRA averaging, DSL achieves higher preference retention (94.56% vs. 87.76%) and a larger GSM8K gain over the base model (22.0 vs. 0.6 points), while reducing upload by 30.6-49.0$\times$. In federated classification, DSL reaches 96.83% on MNIST with 8.9$\times$ less uplink than FedAvg and provides lower-communication operating points on CIFAR-10 and Tiny ImageNet. These results establish random-carrier outputs as a practical communication primitive for knowledge sharing across distinct collaborative learning paradigms.
2610.05378.paper_summary_zh: 協作學習通常交換模型參數：聯邦客戶端傳遞更新，而獨立調整的基礎模型則通過交換適配器或檢查點進行組合。這使得通信隨著模型大小而擴展，並需要在權重空間中調和本地專業化，這裡干擾是常見的。我們詢問是否可以通過模型在與任務無關的輸入上的行為來分享知識。我們介紹了分佈式潛意識學習（DSL），這是一種協作學習原語，參與者在本地調整一個共同模型，使用與任務無關的輸入對其進行探測，並僅傳輸生成的載體輸出。一個協調者將這些輸出集中並提煉成一個共享模型。該原語支持通過載體完成進行一次性基礎模型組合，並通過載體邏輯進行迭代聯邦學習，而無需傳輸模型更新或要求與任務相關的代理數據。在LLM組合中，與LoRA平均相比，DSL實現了更高的偏好保留（94.56%對87.76%）和基於模型的更大GSM8K增益（22.0對0.6點），同時減少了上傳30.6-49.0$\times$。在聯邦分類中，DSL在MNIST上達到96.83%，上行鏈路比FedAvg少8.9$\times$，並在CIFAR-10和Tiny ImageNet上提供了更低通信的操作點。這些結果確立了隨機載體輸出作為跨不同協作學習範式的知識共享的實用通信原語。
